description: Australian waste account is published by Jacob Fry. The study fills gaps in Australia's waste time series and develops more detailed industry allocations. Its stated coverage is Australia; research-derived waste accounts. It covers 2007 to 2019 for 2,310 SA2 regions, 115 generating entities and 69 waste types. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata and lists CSV, XLSX, MATLAB MAT resources; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is cc-by-4.0. This is a derived research product, not the official National Waste Database itself. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
